problem.title: Valid Anagram
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; original Chinese explanation and proof.
facts: Determine whether t is an anagram of s.
The inputs contain lowercase English letters.
The same character multiplicities are required; order is irrelevant.

claims.claim: A 26-slot difference vector is zero exactly when both strings have identical lowercase-letter frequencies.
claims.validation: Frequency-count proof and implementation; deterministic tests.

claims.claim: Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1) under the fixed lowercase-English alphabet.
claims.validation: Two linear scans and a fixed-size 26-element array.
